content.label: This app runs my life. I don’t know what I would do without it. It is endlessly customizable and useful. I can plan my day, use it as a timer, stall out whatever I’m not ready to do, etc.
Charging an extra $4.99 a year for something I already purchased is insane. This app can be recreated in a couple of days. Only a fool would give money to this leech.

I, like many, are quite busy in the day.  My favorite feature is the constant reminders of an event until you turn it off.  So if you miss the first, second, etc.. reminder it keeps on reminding until you turn off.

I've been using Due for years. It does all I need & more. Reliable. Easy to use. Dependable. Great for Short-term & Long-term reminders. Great for One word reminders &/or Lots of words to help my memory:)

I love it. The main feature I was looking for that Apple reminders doesn’t have is being able to very quickly delay a due date/time by an hour or a day or a couple of days. Developer updates regularly to fix bugs and add features.
Really Never forget anything again

This app is great for ADHD repeated reminders, with 4 options on the notification : DONE and 3 time snoozes (globally adjustable not per entry) where I have mine at 1h, 3h, 5pm ... 

And even though the notification is the usual one line, the long press on the notification shows 8 lines so you can see that chunk of your to do list ... And you CAN select per entry the swipe-away repeat time on the reminder, so I treat that as a fourth snooze option

I also cluster my to do items by practicality categories : work, medical, house-outdoors, housecleaning, remind-spouse, long term, for-mom etc 

... And pester myself all day long for "is now a good time to deal with any of the top items on this list"

Wishlist : I wish the alarms had GPS logic and Bluetooth-beacon-logic, hey-you-got-in-the-car, let's remind you about the when-I'm-going-out list ... On-the-couch (Bluetooth beacons on Amazon with dialable range down to 3 feet) = other-list ... Certain games or doomscrolling = other-list after N minutes etc

This is a decent app that keeps reminding you about things when you want them. It just doesn’t have a lot of flexibility with the repeat Reminders. I would love to see something where specific days could be set every week instead, you have to set every single day versus being able to select specific days of the week.

title.label: Perfect but here are the issues

content.label:
Love this app. I can’t use it because:
Needs option to vibrate with the sound!!!
Needs more long sound options!!! There are only 5 ugly long sounds. The rest are around 1 -2 seconds. 
If this is fixed it would be the perfect app.
I couldn’t survive without this app

title.label: Favorite app for years, now unreliable

content.label:
After upgrading to the latest iPhone, I randomly stop getting notifications until I open the app again. I usually only dismiss alerts via notifications, so this bug keeps happening and I keep forgetting to take meds, rendering the app useless. 

I contacted support and they told me my notifications aren't on. 😑
Then how am I getting notifications all the other times?

title.label: Great but syncing could use work

content.label: Love pretty much everything about this app, I've been using it basically since it first came out a million years ago. Recently I got an iPad and I've noticed syncing between the iPhone and iPad is hit or miss. I have incremental sync enabled on all devices. The problem seems to be that Due needs a little time to sync and I have a habit of killing apps when I am done with them. I would think the syncing could be ran as a background process to avoid this issue. Also, if I snooze an alert from the watch or notification I'm not sure how well things sync in that scenario (haven't paid close enough attention there). Anyway, the app is great I just wish this syncing scenario could be handled better.

Due is for todos that I MUST do. It bugs me until I do it, and yet it will snooze when I need it to.  It has a good variety of alarm tones including longer ones that are difficult to miss.  Reminders are easy to make and you can make them recur however you like. The latest update only makes it better.

title.label: Great but not what it promises

content.label: I like this app as it helps keep me on track with the important things and regular tasks I need to be reminded of. I appreciate the flexibility of snooze options. I can set reminders in advance. A frustrating experience that has been consistent and I’ve communicated this without getting solution is that I don’t get consistent notifications on my iWatch and I have issues with the app being problematic where I have to go into the app itself to check notifications and even then have problems.Every update there is I have never had access to even though I pay for the app. I look at how they’re supposed to work and mine doesn’t have those options. I feel like the updates are a scam honestly because I’ve never seen them in the app. Since I’ve gotten it and paid for it the app has always stayed the same with the same features for the past two-three years I’ve been using it. I still use it until I have time to find an alternative app that has more features.

App is great for med reminders cuz of the auto snooze. Been using for years just wish dev would make a normal round + button to add items. I reached out to him about this & said he planned to but that was like 2-3 years ago 😞. Wish it had description title under reminder to put more clarity. But overall it’s a great app just really want a better + button to add task maybe a floating one like most todo apps 🙏🏼

2025 - the app delivers update after update.  Stability and new features.  It is so vital for me.  Meds/Shave/Haircut/Monthly Nagging Tasks like deep clean X room or under X bathroom sink.  Do I become numb to the alerts sure; but also; it’s the most important app for me outside of Native simply for meds & basic hygene

Previous - This app is vital to my productivity workflow.  Never forget again.  Get nagged when you need to, get reminded in those key moments.

Love this app.  Continues to get better and better over time.
I would be lost without it.
I not only use it for timely reminders, but to have it as a flash card app to help me reinforce concepts I want to use to better myself!
I want to have an alarm before the event without using silly hacks like putting the time in the title. Sadly it’s useless for me as is.
I have been using Due for many years. In a sense, my life revolves around it. It is a truly useful and helpful app. Highly recommend.

This app has essentially changed and improved my life….I use it not only for reminders but also favorite quotes, sayings, biblical scriptures, as well as birthdays for friends and family…I have not found a better app that does all of these things that I need to keep my daily life on track…Thank you to all that contribute to the constant improvements and enhancements to the app!

I love using it because:
- the alerts are very persistent and allow for easy snoozing
- actively maintained app
- automatic backups with option to restore to a previous version

title.label: My ADHD needs this to function

content.label: This is utterly indispensable. I use it constantly and have been for years
This flexible task minder is the best app I have found for keeping me organized. Persistent to a fault it won't let you forget anything! Could not do without it given my busy work and personal life.

title.label: Fantastic take on the task list

content.label: There are obviously hundreds of task list apps in the store and I have tried them all... For those of you that have ADD/Adhd I highly recommend giving this a try. My experience has been that making traditional lists has been a disaster in terms of productivity, even something as simple as clear just causes lists to grow forever (Even better if you have an Apple Watch) the nagging regarding small tasks may sound like a bad idea, but it has been a lifesaver. Those of you that are technically inclined will appreciate the robust URL scheme that easily integrates with launcher pro and the like. I'll say again that the nag/snooze features are just about unique and fantastic, results may vary but works great for me.

title.label: The ultimate in your face reminders and timer

content.label: I must say as much as I hate Reminders it’s essential that I keep an eye on them and this is the one app that my face until I take action, it’s not too in your face, but at the same time it’s still a proactive reminder with different levels of notifications.
Love Due. So valuable. I found myself forgetting about appointments, even though they had come up on my calendar. The snooze function of Due is invaluable. I love this app.

title.label: Very nice today with one issue

content.label:
Very nice app. I use for special reminders/todos. Quick to add and have numerous configurations. 

The only issue is that in notifications when the todo pops up you can’t dismiss it without going into the app. Seems to happen only when in another app.
not sure what I would due without it! seriously love the app, especially the flexibility of the the task scheduling
I use this app every day. So great.
This is the only task app that bugs me enough to force me to do things. I’d be lost without it! Love the watch and Siri integrations too.
Works flawlessly again. Excellent app.

I’ve had this app for many years now and I think my favorite thing is the developers Never Stop Working to improve it. I use it daily for reminders and lists of things I don’t want to forget. I love the integration of alarms and how they are viewable from the lock screen. I have ADHD and it is a necessary tool to keep my life on track. Plain and simple, I would not be productive without this app. THANK YOU!!
Does exactly what you need it to do and nothing more - the perfect app.
I depend on this app almost as much as my calendar. Once you learn to unleash it’s simplistic power and usefulness, you will own it for 8 years, like me 😎
I use this app every day. I think my life would fall apart without it!
This app helps me to remember, and also actually get my item completed with the reminder system. It’s quick enough I can just snooze it or do it.
This app transformed my life to help me remember and focus on the things that matter most. An organized and prioritized life is a great life and this app can help you get there!
So easy and handy!

This app is like an extension of my brain. I love the flexibility to change my mind about how often to remind or a zillion other things and the app doesn't fight back - it's very fluid. Oh, and no showoff graphics - plain, straight forward interface. 5/5
If there is some take you absolutely need to take care of Due is the best choice of all. It is almost annoying how persistent it can be. But there are absolutely times that is imperative.
I love this app, but I wish you could have the option for a longer amount of time than an hour between reminders
Needed this to remind me to do something every 2 hours specific times and days of the week. The user interface is not user friendly and I was unable to get it to do what I paid for.

title.label: Love this app - and now it’s working perfect on every device, including my Apple Vision Pro!

content.label:
Edit… since the latest update I feel like the Vision Pro version of the iPad app is not crashing like it used to constantly. I’m really hoping it remains like this. Absolutely love this app. I’ve been paying the subscription for as long as this app has been out and available and it’s the first app I download as I’ve said previously …..
First app I download on every new device. Only app I’ve found that can do the one thing I need, nag me until I relent and respond to the Due notification. It’s easy to temporarily push the notification away to a later time, or accept it and complete the task. It’s a 5 star app. I hope in future the developer can look at fixing the crashing on the Apple Vision Pro. I know this app is not designed for Apple Vision Pro, but I spend most of my day working in AVP, and I use due throughout the day, but it’s difficult to use the app because it crashes so often. I understand this app was NOT designed for AVP, and I’m grateful that it is at least allowed as an iPad app. Thanks!

I love this app. I left a review the other day that the AVP app crashes. Looks like that is fixed. Everything else about this app is amazing. My most used app, and first app I download when I get my iPhone.

title.label: You will not miss a reminder

content.label: This is a great app which makes me not forget things which are very important to me. I still use other reminder apps but this one is for the most important tasks to make extra sure I will not forget them. I wish there would be a Mac version otherwise five stars.
So fast and easy to use. Of all my reminder apps, this one has seen others come and go off my home screen and outlasted them all. I picked this up right when it came out.

I have used Due every day for the last 4 years or more. I first used it to remind me to take medication. I now use it for many other things as well. I especially like that I can set the reminders to bing at different intervals so it keeps at me until I turn it off. It’s my favorite app.

I bought this app to help me remember to do repetitive daily tasks, the problem is that it doesn’t allow you to repeat a task by minute/hour only by day. So this app is kinda useless to me unless I want to set up a bunch of reminders for every 30 mins a day. Another similar app I have called Galarm has this feature (ability to repeat an alarm every x number of minutes) and I assumed it was standard. I like this app’s UX more so wanted to try it but it isn’t useful so I wasted money buying it.
Love it.
